text:
Potsdam’s median asking rent sits at 14.55 €/m² in June 2026, up 8.0 % year‑on‑year and 30.2 % over the past five years, placing the city seventh among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 25th‑percentile level is 11.56 €/m² and the 75th‑percentile 17.44 €/m², while a typical 60 m² unit costs about 873 € per month.

The market is tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.3 % and listings staying on the market only 22 days; 40 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents averages 19.2 %, and asking rents command an 85 % premium over the 2022 census existing rent of 7.85 €/m².

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 15.35 €/m² for the next 12 months, ranging between 14.64 €/m² and 15.72 €/m², implying a further 5.5 % rise.
